Context: 6. Enhancement of ceiling of HBA sanctioned on or after 1-1-2016 but before 9-11-2017.-

- (vi) However, the existing limit of maximum admissible amount of '{ 25 lakhs for the purpose of construction I purchase of new house / flat and '{ 10 lakhs for expansion of existing house/flat would remain unchanged. In other words, the sum total of previously sanctioned House Building Advance and the enhancement granted under these orders cannot exceed the aforesaid limits. In any case, not more than one enhancement is admissible to a Government employee.
